title: Species Gap After Feeder Refill
dataSources: Bird acoustic detections (`birdnet:detection`), wildlife-camera visits (`wildlifecam:visit`), nest-box state (`nestbox:event`), frog-call activity (`frogcall:detection`), and pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`).
app: Wildlife telemetry from BirdNET, trail and feeder cameras, nest-box sensors, frog-call detectors, and pollinator counters streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, APIs, and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birdnet:detection
| stats latest(hours_since_feeder_refill) as hours_since_feeder_refill dc(species) as species_count by feeder
| sort hours_since_feeder_refill
description: Compares species diversity at each feeder against how long it has been since that feeder was refilled.
value: This makes it easier to see whether feeder freshness changes which birds bother to visit your yard.
implementation: Attach feeder-refill timing to BirdNET detections from microphones placed near each feeder.
visualization: Table of species count and time since refill by feeder.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks whether birds visit a feeder differently right after it has been topped up.
